background: WHEREAS the Company is engaged in [description of business] and seeks to raise capital to fund its operations and growth; and WHEREAS the Investor wishes to invest in the Company on the terms and conditions set forth herein; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises and covenants contained in this Agreement, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

standardClauses.title: Closing Conditions
Use of Proceeds
standardClauses.text: The Company shall use the proceeds of the investment solely for: (a) general working capital and operating expenses; (b) product development and engineering; (c) sales, marketing, and business development; and (d) such other purposes as approved by the Board. The Company shall not use the proceeds for: (i) personal expenses of any Founder or officer; (ii) repayment of shareholder loans not previously disclosed to the Investor; or (iii) any purpose unrelated to the Company's business.

standardClauses.title: Expenses
standardClauses.text: Each party shall bear its own legal and professional fees incurred in connection with the negotiation and execution of this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company shall reimburse the Investor for its reasonable legal fees actually incurred in connection with the transaction, up to a maximum of [amount], payable at or promptly following the Closing.

standardClauses.title: Representations and Warranties
Indemnification
standardClauses.text: The Company shall indemnify and hold harmless the Investor and its affiliates, officers, directors, and agents from and against any and all losses, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to: (a) any breach of the Company's representations and warranties; (b) any breach of the Company's covenants or obligations under this Agreement; or (c) any misrepresentation in materials provided to the Investor. This indemnification obligation shall survive the Closing and shall be subject to a cap equal to the Investment Amount.

generalProvisions.title: Amendments
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement may not be amended, modified, or supplemented except by a written instrument signed by the Company and holders of a majority of the outstanding Preferred Stock issued under this Agreement.

generalProvisions.title: Entire Agreement
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement (including all schedules and exhibits) constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, warranties, commitments, offers, and agreements, whether written or oral.

generalProvisions.title: Severability
generalProvisions.text: If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable in any jurisdiction, such invalidity, illegality, or unenforceability shall not affect any other provision of this Agreement, and this Agreement shall be construed as if such invalid, illegal, or unenforceable provision had never been contained herein.

generalProvisions.title: Notices
generalProvisions.text: All notices and other communications under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed given: (a) when delivered personally; (b) when sent by confirmed electronic mail; (c) one (1) business day after being sent by internationally recognized overnight courier; or (d) three (3) business days after being mailed by registered or certified mail, postage prepaid, to the parties at their respective addresses set forth above (or such other address as a party may designate by written notice).

generalProvisions.title: Survival
generalProvisions.text: The representations and warranties, indemnification obligations, confidentiality provisions, and any provisions that by their nature are intended to survive, shall survive the Closing and any termination of this Agreement.

CALIFORNIA.title: California-Specific Provisions
CALIFORNIA.text:
(a) Securities Compliance: The issuance of the Shares shall comply with the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and the California Corporate Securities Law of 1968 (Cal. Corp. Code §25000 et seq.), including any applicable exemptions from registration or qualification.

(b) Blue Sky Laws: The Company shall take all actions necessary to ensure the offer and sale of the Shares comply with applicable state securities laws ("Blue Sky Laws") in each jurisdiction where such compliance is required.

(c) Jury Waiver: EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ALL RIGHTS TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION, PROCEEDING, OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.

(d) The Company shall maintain its qualification to do business in the State of California and shall comply with all applicable provisions of the California Corporations Code.

ENGLAND_WALES.title: England & Wales-Specific Provisions
ENGLAND_WALES.text:
(a) Companies Act 2006 Compliance: The issuance of the Shares shall comply with the Companies Act 2006, including the requirements for allotment of shares (s.549–551), pre-emption rights (s.560–577), and payment for shares (s.580–609).

(b) Pre-Emption Rights: To the extent required, the Company shall procure the disapplication of statutory pre-emption rights under s.561 of the Companies Act 2006 by special resolution of the shareholders prior to the issuance of the Shares.

(c) Share Premium: Any amount paid for the Shares in excess of their nominal value shall be credited to the Company's share premium account in accordance with s.610 of the Companies Act 2006.

(d) Stamp Duty: The Investor shall be responsible for any stamp duty or stamp duty reserve tax payable on the allotment or transfer of the Shares.

(e) Nothing in this Agreement shall exclude or limit any liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law, including liability for fraud.

SPAIN.title: Spain-Specific Provisions (Disposiciones Específicas para España)
SPAIN.text:
(a) Ley de Sociedades de Capital: This Agreement shall comply with the Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 (Ley de Sociedades de Capital, "LSC"), including the provisions governing the issuance of participaciones sociales and the rights of socios.

(b) Junta General: The issuance of the Shares and any amendment to the estatutos sociales required by this Agreement shall be approved by the Junta General of the Company with the majority required by the LSC (art.199 and art.201).

(c) Participaciones Sociales: References to "shares" or "stock" in this Agreement shall be interpreted as references to participaciones sociales of the Company, and the rights and restrictions applicable thereto shall be as set forth in the estatutos sociales.

(d) Derecho de Suscripción Preferente: The statutory derecho de suscripción preferente of existing socios under art.304 LSC shall be addressed as set forth in the Junta General resolution approving the capital increase contemplated by this Agreement.

(e) Registro Mercantil: The capital increase and any amendments to the estatutos sociales contemplated by this Agreement shall be formalized in escritura pública and registered with the Registro Mercantil within the legally required timeframe.

(f) In the event of any conflict between the provisions of this Agreement and mandatory provisions of the LSC, the mandatory provisions of the LSC shall prevail.
